findings.detail: Rows with blank issuer/investment cells and populated cost/fair value totals are structural subtotal rows that leaked into private_markets_holdings as positions.

rationale: C201 flags holdings rows whose issuer_name is blank. The raw SOI grid shows structural subtotal lines with empty investment/name cells but populated cost and fair value amounts; these are not issuer-bearing positions and should not be emitted as holdings records with missing issuer_name. Normal adjacent rows carry issuer names, confirming the blank-name numeric rows are structural rollups rather than valid unnamed positions.
